question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"clung."****

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "clung" means to hold on tightly to somebody/something. (चिपकना, लिपटना, जुड़े रहना)

 
 
• Example: *She **clung**__ to the rope with all her strength.*
 
 
 
• The paragraph conveys that she did her best to remove the sticky web material that was stuck to her arm.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph:

Outside, the world had become a formless, __amorphous__ with no shape, while the house itself seemed to have twisted and stretched. There was sticky web-stuff __**clung**__ to her arm, and she wiped it off as best as she could. The other mother was waiting for her, standing on the grass with her arms ______ (3) ______. Her black button eyes were expressionless, but her lips were pressed tightly in a cold ______ (4) ______. When she saw Myna she reached ______ (5) _______ one long white hand, and she crooked a finger.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Unmoor: **release the moorings of (a vessel). ((एक जहाज) का लंगर छोड़ना)
 
• **Dried: **to become dry; to make something dry. ((किसी वस्‍तु का) सूखना; (किसी वस्‍तु को) सुखाना)
 
• **Manumit: **release from slavery; set free. (गुलामी से मुक्ति; आजाद करना)
